writer.note: Episodes written per weekly run (the review runs Mon + Thu = 8 a week; each episode gives 1 Short + 1 long; the schedule uses 7 Shorts and 4 long videos a week).

budget.note: Render minutes this channel's daily videos may use per month. Account allowance ~3,000 Linux minutes ($18, GitHub Pro): Project 1 ~600, this channel's weekly reviews ~170 and music bank ~390 (while it fills), daily renders 1,300 -> ~2,450 in total. Long videos drop from 4K to 1440p/1080p automatically when the month would not fit.

social.note: YouTube, Facebook, TikTok and Snapchat are scheduled for the same moment; Instagram is published at that time by release.yml (its times must match shortTimes). TikTok/Snapchat need the ZERNIO_* secrets; without them they are skipped.
